## Business focus
Visitors may call Tyler to discuss:
- Vehicle and work-truck repair
- Diesel repair
- Mechanical diagnosis and repair
- Body work and parts replacement
- Paint and body-work materials
- Fabrication and custom repair requests

Specific services, availability, estimates, parts, labor, scheduling, payment, pickup, and warranty terms must be confirmed directly for each job.

## Calling PALMERS REPAIR LLC
Callers should be ready to provide the vehicle year, make, model, engine, mileage, VIN when relevant, symptoms or damage, requested work, location, and timeline.

## Important limitations
The website does not guarantee that every listed service is available. It does not promise certifications, financing, towing, delivery, fixed pricing, turnaround times, or warranties. Tyler must confirm the exact job and terms before work begins.
